$comment: A one-second Ice Mirror deflection built from the saved idle scene. Exactly three hero crystals keep their vertical bubble motion.
name: Ice Shield - Mirror Deflect
description: A shard strikes the upper-right hex, flashes with a prism glint, bends away, and clears with a short icy trail while the three idle crystals keep bobbing.
author: vfx-pipeline

layers.note: Exactly three distinct prepared hero crystals bob on their existing vertical lanes; five minor shards remain secondary.
Eight small snowflake cards keep the idle's quiet companion motion.
The same cold transparent, ground-pointing equal-sided hex holds at full size.
One faint cyan outline follows the six-sided screen.
One faceted shard contacts the upper-right, bends up and away, and leaves a short frost trail.
